sourceTitle: Chenodia Or, the Classical Mother Goose
description: "Chenodia" by Jacob Bigelow is a playful collection of children's verses written in the late 19th century. This work is a unique interpretation of the classic "Mother Goose" rhymes, blending classic and modern styles of poetry.
